start.text: Pip had one dream — earn the shiny firefighter helmet hanging on the wall. But every single thing in this station was built for animals ten times his size.

a.text: Under the engine, Pip found a tiny pink squeaky mouse and tucked it into his collar — finally, something in this station that was actually his size.

aa.text: The boot swallowed Pip whole — he shuffled across the checkered floor like the world's most determined piece of footwear.

bb.text: Pip jumped and jumped, but the bell rope dangled just out of reach — mocking him with a gentle swing each time he missed.

scare.reveal: That bell finally rang — using my head!

m1.text: A tiny meow echoed from the drainpipe — the station's kitten mascot was stuck where no big firefighter could possibly fit. But someone Pip's size? Perfect.

m2.text: Inside the locker, the gear ranged from too-big to way-too-big — except for one curious little yellow vest tucked in the back like it had been waiting for someone exactly Pip's size.

m3.text: A frightened meow came from the drainpipe — the kitten mascot was wedged in tight, and every firefighter at the station was too big to reach her. Every firefighter except one.

m4.text: The tire course stretched out ahead — the big animals always got hopelessly stuck in it, but those gaps looked just Pip-sized.

The dalmatian chief salutes and the raccoon firefighter wipes a tear. end_whistle_lure.text: One squeak of the little pink mouse and the kitten came trotting right out. The Chief placed the golden helmet on Pip's head and said he was the bravest firefighter of all — no matter the size. The End!

All the animal firefighters cheer around them. Bold cheerful flat-color picture-book art, fire-engine reds and sunny yellows, gleaming chrome and checkered floors, friendly animal firefighters in uniform. Landscape orientation. end_bucket_rescue.text: Pip slid the little red bucket in, the kitten hopped aboard, and out they came. One bucket-sized rescue later, Pip had his helmet and a kitten who refused to stop following him home. The End!

end_oops_sock.text: Pip hauled on the rope with all his might and out came one ancient, extremely smelly sock. The kitten strolled out on her own and gave him a look that said everything. Oopsie ending!

end_oops_helmet.text: The enormous helmet swallowed Pip even faster than the boot did — he wobbled three steps and belly-flopped into the mop bucket with a spectacular splash. At least he was the cleanest pup at the station. Oopsie ending!

end_vest_hero.text: The yellow vest fit like it had been made just for him — because it had, tucked away in the back of the locker for exactly this day. Chief pinned on a badge and named Pip the station's official small-spaces rescue pup. The End!

end_team_rescue.text: One blast of the whistle brought the gecko running, and together they coaxed the kitten free. The Chief gave them both helmets — the station's smallest heroes and its proudest. The End!

The dalmatian chief holds out a tiny golden firefighter helmet. The green gecko cheers from an orange cone. end_solo_rescue.text: Pip shined the flashlight ahead, wiggled in, and nudged the kitten free with his nose. Dusty and grinning, he emerged to find the Chief waiting with a helmet that finally fit. The End!

end_tiny_champ.scene: {HERO} sitting drenched in an overturned silver water bucket at the end of the tire obstacle course, the dalmatian chief wiping water off his face with a stunned expression, orange training cones scattered everywhere, the green gecko proudly holding up a tiny flag from the last tire. Bold cheerful flat-color picture-book art, fire-engine reds and sunny yellows, gleaming chrome and checkered floors, friendly animal firefighters in uniform. Landscape orientation. end_tiny_champ.text: Pip zoomed through the tires so fast he could not stop — he shot out the end like a furry cannonball, bounced off a training cone, ricocheted into the water bucket, and splashed the Chief right in the face. The gecko held up a tiny ten-out-of-ten sign for the landing, though. Oopsie ending!

end_cozy_nap.scene: {HERO} blinking awake in the dark empty training yard at night, still wrapped in the red wool blanket inside the last tire, the green gecko snoring on his head, the fire station dark and locked behind them, a crescent moon overhead and no other animal in sight. Bold cheerful flat-color picture-book art, fire-engine reds and sunny yellows, gleaming chrome and checkered floors, friendly animal firefighters in uniform. Landscape orientation. end_cozy_nap.text: Pip snuggled into the warm blanket and fell asleep so deeply he missed the entire afternoon, the graduation ceremony, AND dinner. He woke up at midnight in a dark empty yard with the gecko snoring on his head and absolutely no idea what day it was. Oopsie ending!
